title: Bram and the Asset
author: C. M. Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Dunmore, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
